implementationProposal.voiceModeLabel: 逐轮语音练习; it is a usable fallback, not evidence that realtime WebSocket audio works
implementationProposal.browserMicrophoneRequirement: getUserMedia requires a secure context. The existing public HTTP IP origin cannot directly capture a microphone in ordinary browsers. Provide a trusted HTTPS entry point or a separately implemented native recorder; uploading an existing audio file remains possible over HTTP.
implementationProposal.serverBoundary: Provider credentials stay in the server; browser uses the same application session. Every upload/download/transcription/synthesis request checks user ownership and origin. Realtime proxy must authenticate before connecting upstream and close upstream when the user disconnects.
implementationProposal.stateAndCosts: Persist explicit failure state, reserve and settle credits atomically, avoid repeated paid requests on a retry using a request identifier, and record unknown provider usage as null. Do not infer token usage for audio endpoints that do not report it.
implementationProposal.mediaLifecycle: Bound upload byte size and recording duration, inspect actual MIME/signature, use opaque private asset IDs, prevent path-based downloads, and remove abandoned files with a defined retention policy.
implementationProposal.nativeRecording: APK native capture requires Android microphone permission and user-triggered recording; only expose the bridge to the configured trusted application origin. No recording has been implemented or device-tested by this probe.
